apps.name: Math Mastery: Kids Games
apps.description: Turn math practice into a fun adventure with Math Mastery: Kids Games! Designed for young students, our app transforms the challenge of learning addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division into a series of exciting, gamified challenges. Say goodbye to boring drills and hello to fun learning!

apps.name: TheCore Game
apps.description: In this cool game, the player has an amount of bullets to shoot and hit the target which is "The Core", the center of the circles. The challenge is to be able to reach the center, with the amount of the given and earned bullets in the amount of the time provided.
